narrative:
The consolidated Rare Disease plan bridges from USD 7.71B FY2025 net sales to USD 8.35B FY2026 Plan. Patient volume growth adds USD 850M, launches and label expansions USD 120M, and price and mix USD 96M. Soliris biosimilar erosion (-USD 330M) and US GTN pressure (-USD 95M) offset part of that.

The finance gate passes: the plan is 1.8% below the USD 8.5B CFO target (within the 3% tolerance), with a 41.8% contribution margin against a 40% floor. Ultomiris now accounts for 83% of complement revenue.

Every number here traces back to governed actuals on Snowflake. This is the first planning workload the containment programme can retire off a standalone platform.
